facts: input is a string or an item array; item type 'message' (EasyInputMessage) carries role + content; 'instructions' is a separate top-level field
FunctionCall input item: {type:'function_call', call_id, name, arguments (JSON string)}
FunctionTool is FLAT in the Responses API: {type:'function', name, description, parameters, strict} — no nested 'function' wrapper
reasoning.effort enum: none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh | max
tool_choice strings: auto | none | required (object forms exist for hosted tools / custom)
max_output_tokens is the Responses-API output limit field
notes: Fixture assembled from the create-response request schema on the cited reference page. The item sequence models a tool round trip: user message, assistant function_call item, function_call_output — the canonical shape Claude Code-style agent loops produce. Image input items ({type:'input_image'}) are covered by the unit-test matrix, not this fixture, to keep it minimal.
